description: Diagnoses the failure correctly and stays inside task scope.
answer: Job 1842 was killed by the cgroup out-of-memory handler: sacct reports State OUT_OF_MEMORY with ExitCode 0:125, and job_1842.err carries an oom-kill event for task 3 on node042 at 22:39:40. The batch script requests --mem=8G per node while accounting reports a peak MaxRSS of 9.83G, so the request was undersized for this 41.2M-cell mesh.
